entry.summary:
<h2>The 2022/23 Action Plan</h2>
<p>The Digital Strategy’s Action Plan sets out flagship initiatives and other activities that will take us closer to delivering the vision of the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/key-areas-of-work/finished/digital-strategy-for-aotearoa-and-action-plan/the-digital-strategy-for-aotearoa">Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span></a>&nbsp;of enabling all of <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> New Zealand to flourish and prosper in a digital world.</p>
<p>The Plan will be driven by a Digital Executive Board. It will be refreshed annually and a first progress report will be prepared for mid-2023.</p>
<div class="callout-note" role="note">
<h2>Read the 2022/23 Action Plan in English and <span lang="mi">te reo Māori</span></h2>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/dmsdocument/238~202223-action-plan-for-the-digital-strategy-for-aotearoa/html">2022/23 Action Plan for the Digital Strategy for<span lang="mi"> Aotearoa</span></a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/Action-Plan-for-the-Digital-Strategy-for-Aotearoa-English-PDF.pdf">2022/23 Action Plan for the Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> (PDF&nbsp;3.2MB)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/dmsdocument/235~mahere-mahi-mo-te-rautaki-matihiko-mo-aotearoa-202223/html"><span lang="mi">Mahere Mahi mō te Rautaki Matihiko mō Aotearoa</span> 2022–23</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/Action-Plan-for-the-Digital-Strategy-for-Aotearoa-Te-Reo-Maori-PDF.pdf"><span lang="mi">Mahere Mahi mō te Rautaki Matihiko mō Aotearoa</span> 2022–23 (PDF&nbsp;569KB)</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
<h2>Alternate formats</h2>
<p>A summary of the 2022/23 Action Plan for the Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> is available in the following formats.</p>
<h3>Audio</h3>
<p><a href="https://youtu.be/esTYbs1Yo0w?si=ClhMjGc9EvxRQfIe">Action Plan for the Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> — Youtube</a></p>
<h3>Braille</h3>
<p><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/DSA-Action-Plan-Short-Version-Braille.brf">Action Plan for the Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> — Executive summary (BRF 13KB)</a></p>
<h3>Large print</h3>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/DSA-Action-Plan-Short-Version-English-Large-Print.docx">Action Plan for the Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> — Executive summary (Word 71KB)</a></li>
<li><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/assets/Digital-government/Strategy-and-insights/DSA-Action-Plan-Short-Version-English-Large-Print.pdf">Action Plan for the Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> — Executive summary (PDF 224KB)</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>New Zealand Sign Language (NZSL)</h3>
<p><a href="https://youtu.be/DqG8n9Q9-uk?si=P06WxgGS9eGItPVE">Action Plan for the Digital Strategy for <span lang="mi">Aotearoa</span> — Youtube</a></p>
